title: Temporal Topic Narrative Graph
description: A narrative laid out on a grid: time runs along the columns, tracks (topics or entities) down the rows. The graph editor (apps/web) reads and edits this shape. It also accepts the same object wrapped as {"graph": {...}}; this schema describes the unwrapped form. The editor ignores any edges in a file and derives them again with the rule in apps/web/utils/computeEdges.ts.

edges.description: Derived data. Nothing reads it back on import, so a file does not need to carry it.

sources.description: Web pages the nodes were grounded in, when the graph was generated from real news.

label.description: Persistent display label such as v1, assigned by the editor.

track.description: Row index, starting at 0. A negative value means the node is off the grid; the edge rule ignores it.

motifSource.description: Which motif or generator created the node. Metadata only.

attributes.description: Named lists of values, for example Entity, Topic, Time Period. One attribute organises the tracks and one links nodes together.

content.description: The narrative text of the node.
